resources.string: Merge colourful pucks or clear pairs in a seeded challenge
Slide, bounce and merge colourful pucks before the board fills up
Place your puck anywhere in the base, pull back, then release
Choose a clear spot in the base and pull backwards
Start a new board? Points earned on this board will be converted into neutrinos.
The pucks are overflowing into the base

Touch any clear spot in the shaded base, both sideways and in depth. Pull backwards to aim towards the board, then release. A short pull makes a gentle shot with enough speed to leave the base; a longer pull sends the puck further. To cancel, bring your finger back to its starting point.

Matching colours merge into a larger puck. The row at the bottom shows all 12 ranks in order, with your current colour outlined. Chain merges during one shot to multiply points, up to ×8. Two rank 11 pucks produce a smaller rank 12 puck; two rank 12 pucks disappear for a bonus and free up space.

The line above the base lets your shot through, then bounces returning pucks back into play. A bad rebound alone does not end the game. If the board is so full that pucks remain pushed across the line, it turns red: you have a short grace period for movement or merges to clear the overflow before the game ends.

Wait for the pucks to stop before shooting again. The dotted guide estimates travel and rail bounces up to the first puck. Your next colour appears in the bottom right of the base.

Your board is saved when you leave. Best scores are separate from Accretion. Earn one neutrino per %1$d points, paid when the game ends or you start a new board.
